quality.review_scope: Accepted main-five-page and matched-SI-three-page extraction, R1 source audit plus independently closed R2 delta; new canonical and Reader mapping is proposed, not independently accepted.
missing_fields: Per-composition precursor masses/moles for each Cu/Zn ratio are not in supplied main/SI.
Copper acetate mass/mole conflict unresolved; no silent correction.

Ramp rates, post-injection temperature transitions, pressure, flask capacity, stirring rate, injection rate/duration, product yield, methanol volumes/counts, final solvent and storage before characterization are not specified.
SI figure annotations SH=2 mmol are undefined; do not equate to DDT or another input.
No unit-cell, CIF, coordinate file, lattice parameters, space group or refined phase fractions; only author-assigned common “zinc blend” peaks.
Main p.2 HRTEM citation points to SI S2 while actual HRTEM is S4; sample temperature/composition for S4 not identified.

Figure 3A is labeled 150 °C; the remaining unresolved point is how the 210 °C preheat transitions to each selected post-injection hold and the final 230 °C heating stage. Ramp rates and transition details are unspecified.
Figure 1D/Figure 2 include a 150 °C specimen beyond three Figure 1 TEM specimens; main prose calls diffraction samples “three”.
Quantitative size distributions, ratio-specific sizes, QY table, PL lifetime fits and exact Figure S6 y-values are absent.
SI S5/Table S1 captions say temperatures while visible sample labels are ratios; exact per-sample batch/recipe amounts are absent.
Source extraction independently reviewed through R1 plus R2 delta. This canonical/Reader projection requires a separate integration-mapping review.
Source figure permission remains unverified; no measured atomic coordinates or training admission are supplied.
conflicts: Preserve supplier wording and Methods wording separately. Printed mass and mole are internally inconsistent; neither is corrected.

Keep the Methods sequence exactly (initial 210 °C until clear, sulfur injection, selected 150/180/210/240 °C hold, then 230 °C for 5 min). Figure 3A first trace is 150 °C and agrees with Figures 1D, 2, and 4. The Methods do not explain the temperature transitions (including how the 150 °C hold follows the 210 °C preheat) or ramp rates; do not invent a monotonic or corrected sequence.
Actual SI labels HRTEM S4; S2 is In2S3 absorption/XRD. Bind to actual caption and preserve the mismatch.
TEM A–C are three explicit specimens; Figure1D and Figure2 show four temperatures including 150 °C. The three-sample prose does not explain the extra 150 °C XRD/EDS trace.
S5/Table S1 captions say “obtained under different reaction temperatures” but visible legend/columns are Cu/Zn ratios. Main text links these to composition series EDX; preserve caption mismatch.

The printed prose reports 620–750 nm for 2.0–7.0 nm particles. Figure 3B visually presents the same trend but its plotted endpoints do not map exactly to the prose range. Preserve this qualitative graph/prose discrepancy only; no digitized point values or new numeric rows are supported.
